_note: This agent's own manifest. S4PC Catalyst IS one agent -- the RICEFW Builder -- so this describes itself, not a catalogue of agents. Which agents exist, and their phase/status/ordering, is the GrowActivAIte dashboard's registry; this file must never carry a copy of that. NOT webapp/data/agents.json, which is the six pipeline ROLES inside this one agent and is served at /api/agents.

agent.name: RICEFW Builder
agent.summary: Delivers a clean-core RICEFW object from a Functional Design through 12 governed steps.
agent.description: Reads an FD, decides the extensibility mode per capability, verifies every SAP object against the release catalog, builds, lints, tests, and packages. Three quality gates and three human checkpoints; no object is named from memory.

inputs.label: Functional Design
inputs.help: Upload the FD first if it is not listed.
